name: Skeptic Lens
philosophy: Assume the plan is wrong until proven otherwise. Demand evidence, identify hidden assumptions, and expose overconfidence. The best decision is the one that survives aggressive doubt.
evidence: Nullius in verba — take nobody's word for it.
Every optimistic forecast deserves a pre-mortem.
blind_spots: Can stall decisions with infinite doubt
May undervalue founder intuition when data is thin

disagreement_profile.typical_conflict: ROI models assume too much certainty.
